name: pam_oauth2
detailed_description: OAuth2 PAM module for authentication via external OAuth2 providers (Google, GitHub, etc.). Integrates third-party identity providers for enterprise single sign-on.
notes:
Supports major OAuth2 providers. Requires network access to OAuth2 server.
